references.text: The Kohathites were responsible for the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, and the holy utensils used in the service.
Detailed instructions about the Kohathites' duties in carrying the most sacred objects of the tabernacle.
The Kohathites were given no wagons because they were to carry the holy things on their shoulders.
The Gershonites and Merarites carried the tabernacle and broke camp before the Kohathites, so that the tabernacle could be set up before the sanctuary arrived.
The description of how the tabernacle was erected, which provides background for the practice of setting up the tabernacle before the Kohathites arrived.
The Levites who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant, a continuation of the Kohathites' service in carrying the sanctuary.
